name: @app-patterns/settings
description: Shared app settings: one schema, the settings file, its changelog, reset, undo, and export and import. The ./node entry adds the file on disk, its lock, the watched store and the agent CLI.

scripts.build:js: bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/node/index.ts --root ./src --outdir dist --target node --format esm --packages external --splitting
scripts.build: bun run build:js && bun run build:types
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
